wineCard.wishlistHint: Wishlist = wines you want to try. Cellar = bottles you already own.
wineCard.likeHint: Tasted and loved it? This teaches us your taste and improves recommendations.
wineCard.spectrumTapHint: Tap any bar to learn more
wineCard.spectrumBodyHint: How heavy the wine feels in your mouth
wineCard.spectrumTanninHint: The drying, gripping sensation from grape skins
wineCard.spectrumSweetnessHint: How much residual sugar the wine has
wineCard.spectrumAcidityHint: How fresh and crisp the wine tastes
wineCard.spectrumBodyExplain: Body is how heavy or light a wine feels in your mouth. Light wines are refreshing and delicate, like Pinot Noir. Bold wines are rich and full, like Cabernet Sauvignon.
wineCard.spectrumTanninExplain: Tannins create a drying, gripping sensation in your mouth. Smooth wines feel silky and easy to drink. Tannic wines have more structure and pair well with rich food.
wineCard.spectrumSweetnessExplain: Ranges from bone-dry (no residual sugar) to sweet (dessert-like). Most red wines are dry; Riesling and Moscato are examples of sweeter styles.
wineCard.spectrumAcidityExplain: Acidity makes wine taste fresh and lively. Soft wines feel rounder and mellow. Acidic wines are crisp and zesty, great with food.

profile.spectrumBodyExplain: Body is how heavy or light a wine feels in your mouth. Light wines are refreshing and delicate, like Pinot Noir. Bold wines are rich and full, like Cabernet Sauvignon.
profile.spectrumTanninExplain: Tannins create a drying, gripping sensation in your mouth. Smooth wines feel silky and easy to drink. Tannic wines have more structure and pair well with rich food.
profile.spectrumSweetnessExplain: Ranges from bone-dry (no residual sugar) to sweet (dessert-like). Most red wines are dry; Riesling and Moscato are examples of sweeter styles.
profile.spectrumAcidityExplain: Acidity makes wine taste fresh and lively. Soft wines feel rounder and mellow. Acidic wines are crisp and zesty, great with food.
profile.overallStyleExplain: The general character of wines you enjoy — the vibe and experience you're drawn to.
profile.bodyStructureExplain: How heavy or light your preferred wines feel. Structure includes tannins and acidity — the wine's backbone.
profile.fruitProfileExplain: The fruit flavors you tend to enjoy — from bright red berries to dark plums and tropical fruits.
profile.styleNotesExplain: Beyond fruit: oak, vanilla, spice, earth, and minerality. These notes shape the wine's complexity.
profile.recommendedGrapesExplain: Grape varieties that produce wines matching your taste. Look for these on wine labels.
profile.recommendedRegionsExplain: Wine regions known for producing styles you enjoy. A great starting point when browsing wine shops.
profile.whatToAvoidExplain: Based on your preferences, these styles might not suit your palate.
profile.summaryExplain: A personalized overview of your wine personality — like advice from a sommelier friend.

guide.title: App Guide
guide.subtitle: Everything you need to get the most out of WineJourney.
guide.quickstartIntro: Get started with WineJourney in 4 easy steps.
guide.quickstart_addWines_desc: Search for wines you love and tap 'I like this wine' to build your taste profile. This unlocks personalized match scores, full wine analysis, and Pier as your smart sommelier.
guide.quickstart_scan_desc: Point your camera at the front of any wine bottle or type a name to instantly get tasting notes, ratings, and your personal match score.
guide.quickstart_ask_desc: Ask anything — food pairings, recommendations for tonight, or help choosing between two bottles. Your AI sommelier knows your taste.
guide.quickstart_collect_desc: Add wines to your cellar and organize them in a customizable 3D rack. Track drinking windows and see readiness heatmaps.
guide.quickstartTipDesc: The more wines you search and like, the smarter your sommelier becomes. Try searching for a wine you already love to kickstart your profile.
guide.featuresIntro: WineJourney helps you discover, collect, and enjoy wine — with an AI sommelier by your side. Here's what you can do.
guide.feature_search_desc: Snap the front of a wine bottle with your camera or search by name. Get detailed tasting notes, ratings, and a personal match score that shows how well it fits your taste.
guide.feature_sommelier_desc: Your AI wine advisor. Ask for food pairings, discover new wines based on your taste, or get a recommendation for tonight's dinner.
guide.feature_cellar_desc: Organize your collection in a customizable wine rack. See readiness heatmaps, track drinking windows, and manage your inventory with a visual overview.
guide.feature_wishlist_desc: Save wines you want to try. When you buy one, mark it as purchased and it moves straight to your cellar — with an option to place it in your rack.
guide.feature_profile_desc: Your evolving wine personality. The app learns what you love across reds, whites, and more, and refines every recommendation over time.
guide.faq_q1: How does the taste profile work?
guide.faq_a1: When you search for wines and mark them as 'I like this,' the app builds a profile of your preferences. The more wines you interact with, the more accurate your recommendations become.
guide.faq_q2: Can I scan any wine bottle?
guide.faq_a2: Yes! Point your camera at the front of any wine bottle and the app will identify it using AI. It works best with clear, well-lit photos of the front of the bottle.
guide.faq_q3: What can I ask the sommelier?
guide.faq_a3: Anything wine-related! Ask for food pairings, recommendations for an occasion, help choosing from your cellar, buying advice, or general wine knowledge. It uses your taste profile for personalized answers.
guide.faq_q4: How do I organize my wine cellar?
guide.faq_a4: Go to the Cellar tab and switch to the 3D Rack view. You can customize the rack size, assign bottles to specific slots, and see a readiness heatmap showing which wines to drink now.
guide.faq_a5: Yes. Your taste profile, cellar, and conversation history are private to your account. We don't share personal data with third parties.
guide.faq_q6: How do I switch between Hebrew and English?
guide.faq_a6: Go to Settings and tap your preferred language. The entire app, including AI recommendations, will switch to your chosen language.

tour.step_search_desc: Point your camera at the front of any wine bottle to instantly identify it, or search by name. Get tasting notes, ratings, and your personal match score.
tour.step_sommelier_desc: Chat naturally with your personal sommelier. Ask for recommendations, food pairings, or help choosing from your cellar. It learns your taste over time.
tour.step_cellar_desc: Organize your wine collection in a beautiful 3D rack. Track drinking windows, see readiness heatmaps, and get suggestions for what to open tonight.
tour.step_enjoy_desc: The more you interact, the smarter your recommendations get. Save wines to your wishlist, build your taste profile, and enjoy a personalized wine journey.

plans.title: Choose Your Plan
plans.subtitle: Find the right plan for your wine journey
plans.betaBanner: During the beta period, all features are open and free! Enjoy the full WineJourney experience.
plans.tasteFull: Full taste profile with match scores
plans.feature1Desc: Get personalized advice, food pairings, and buying recommendations — Pier knows your taste inside out.
plans.feature2Desc: Tell Pier about your evening — occasion, food, mood — and get the perfect bottle from your own cellar.
plans.feature3Desc: Expand your palate with wines matched to your taste profile. Never buy a disappointing bottle again.
plans.feature4Desc: Know exactly what's in your collection, what's ready to drink, and what gaps to fill next.
plans.addonsDesc: Pro users can purchase add-on packages when they reach their monthly cap:
plans.faq1Q: Can I upgrade or downgrade later?
plans.faq1A: Yes! You can change your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately, and downgrades apply at the end of your billing cycle.
plans.faq2Q: What happens when I reach my monthly limit?
plans.faq2A: You'll see a friendly notification. Free and Plus users can upgrade for more. Pro users can purchase add-on packages.
plans.faq3Q: Is my data safe if I downgrade?
plans.faq3A: Absolutely. Your wine data, taste profile, and cellar are always preserved regardless of your plan.
plans.faq4Q: Will pricing change after the beta?
plans.faq4A: Beta users will receive 30 days of free access to all features when paid plans launch.
